summary: Iteration 152 — Tested the new Image Copyright/Attribution enforcement (Clara). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass covering GET/PUT /api/content/{id}/image-rights (structured object round-trip, legacy-string accepted as credit, empty-clears), publish-clara gating with Dutch 'rechten' error, success after rights filled, list-endpoint missing_image_attributions flag, and News API <figcaption class='clara-img-credit'> injection + image_attribution JSON. Frontend: verified on /radiogroep/content — 8 missing-rights badges visible (matches PRD), clicking through opens ContentDetailPage where ImageRightsModal auto-opens with Dutch labels, all 4 fields per row (Bron, Fotograaf, Licentie, URL naar origineel), Later invullen closes the modal without saving, publish-clara-btn becomes disabled and rights-blocked-warning is shown and reopens the modal. Filling only Bron + Save closes the modal, removes the warning, enables publish-clara-btn, turns the toolbar Afbeeldingsrechten button from amber to neutral, and removes the library badge on reload (8→7).

issues: Console a11y warning: DialogContent missing DialogTitle / aria-describedby — non-functional but should be wrapped in VisuallyHidden or have a DialogTitle. Affects all dialogs across the app.

action_items: Optional a11y polish: add DialogTitle/VisuallyHidden to ImageRightsModal (and other Radix Dialogs) to silence the screen-reader warning logged in the console.
critical_code_review_comments: content.py is still ~2225 lines — should be split into modules (image_rights.py, featured_image.py, publishing.py, approval.py). Image-rights helpers (_normalize_attribution, _content_has_missing_image_attribution, _build_image_rights_status) are well-isolated and could move out cleanly.
ImageRightsUpdate uses Dict[str, object] — Pydantic accepts both strings and dicts which is exactly what _normalize_attribution handles. Good backwards-compatible design.

news_public._has_missing_image_attribution duplicates the same logic as content._content_has_missing_image_attribution and content._INLINE_IMG_SRC_RE. Consider extracting to a shared helpers module to avoid drift (DRY violation, ~10 line block).

publish-clara enforcement order is: approved → featured image → image rights. The Dutch 'rechten' error only fires when the first two pass — that's correct UX-wise but the test must set everything up in that order. Confirmed working.

_build_image_attribution in news_public also reads top-level item.get('photo_credit') etc., supporting legacy items where the credit was stored on the item rather than under featured_image. Good defense-in-depth.

FeaturedImageAttributionUpdate accepts None and unconditionally overwrites all five fields — this means PUT with only photo_credit set will clear photo_photographer/photo_license. Frontend ImageRightsModal sends only featured-image keys for featured image; main agent should verify it always sends the full bundle (or switch endpoint to PATCH semantics).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — modal auto-open, all 4 fields, Later invullen, Save, warning, badge removal, publish enabling all verified
